newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-League of Ireland premier division fixtures.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-League of Ireland premier division fixtures.

text.p: This weekend's national league of Ireland premier division fixtures. All kick-off times are given in GMT.
Bohemians vs St.Patrick's Athletic at Dalymount Park, 1945 GMT.
Dundalk vs Derry City at Oriel Park, 1945 GMT.
Shamrock Rovers vs Bray Wanderers at Tolka Park, 1945 GMT.
Finn Harps vs Home Farm/Everton at Finn Park, 1930 GMT.
Sligo Rovers vs Shelbourne at Showgrounds, 1930 GMT.
University College Dublin vs Cork City at Belfield Park, 1515 GMT.
